messages:
Harper: Quick wrap from the surge window — creating a compact action tickler so we can close this loop. Root cause: bursty long-running batch jobs plus slow autoscale reactions.
Sandeep: Thanks. Can we distill to 4 concrete actions with owners and hard ETAs? I'll take scheduler changes.
Harper: Proposed concise list: 
1) Scheduler policy: change preempt and binpack weighting for batch pods (owner: Sandeep). ETA: validate in staging within 48h.
2) Autoscaler rules: reduce scale-down grace to 18s and add headroom rule based on queued GPU requests (owner: Theo). ETA: canary in 24h.
3) Quota window: request a temporary +20% GPU pool for an 36h validation window (ticket CAP-8017). Owner: Maya. ETA: submit now and ask for provisional approval.
4) Closure doc: one-page checklist with exact commands, rollback snippets, and escalation list (owner: Harper). ETA: PR by EOD.
Maya: CAP-8017 opened and tagged billing/cloud. Link: https://infra.company/tickets/CAP-8017. Requested provisional 36h window and included cost estimate.
Theo: Autoscaler snippet I'll test in staging:
```
kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"scaleDownGrace":"18s","minHeadroom":"0.10"}}'
```
Sandeep: Scheduler commands for runbook:
```
# adjust binpack weight
kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"binPackWeight":"0.8","preemptThreshold":"0.65"}}'
```
capacity-bot: Task created: CAP-8017 linked to INC-4210. Calendar: follow-up check in 2025-12-02 08:30 PT.
Harper: Owners recap: Sandeep (scheduler), Theo (autoscaler), Maya (quota), Harper (doc + closure). Acceptance for close: CAP-8017 approved OR surge incidents reduced >=50% for 14 days post-change. Weekly pulse for 2 weeks after close.
Maya: Will ping billing for provisional approve and update this thread.
Theo: I'll upload staging perf graphs when canary completes and add a perf gate in the PR.
Sandeep: Adding a lint/test for scheduler policy to prevent regressions. Will link PR in this thread.
Harper: Thanks — if someone needs to hand off, drop a name and backup. I'll update the incident tracker and mark the follow-up in progress.
